name: PostgreSQL Connector
description: Connect to PostgreSQL databases for Change Data Capture (CDC), query-based ingestion, or batch data extraction. Supports logical replication for real-time streaming.

entity.name: PostgreSQL
entity.description: PostgreSQL database connector with CDC and query-based ingestion support
required_permissions: REPLICATION (CDC only — not required for discovery, preview, or snapshot/incremental sample)

auth_mode=iam: the runtime principal needs rds-db:connect on arn:aws:rds-db:REGION:ACCOUNT:dbuser:PROXY_RESOURCE_ID/DB_USERNAME. The database user needs the rds_iam role, and the RDS Proxy must have IAM authentication enabled. Do not store the auth token.

connection_string.help: Optional postgres:// URL; with resolution flexible, passed to pg as connectionString when set.

host.help: Discrete host when not using connection_string.

username.help: Database user. For auth_mode=iam this is the rds_iam user.

auth_mode.help: password uses a stored secret. iam signs a fresh RDS auth token for each physical connection (RDS Proxy). Requires ssl_mode=verify-full, ssl_ca, and rds-db:connect. No password and no connection_string.

aws_region.help: Region of the RDS Proxy or database. Required for auth_mode=iam when it differs from the runtime AWS_REGION.

ssl_mode.help: Remote hosts default to require. verify-ca and verify-full need ssl_ca (PEM).

ssl_ca.help: CA PEM for verify-ca / verify-full. Externalized like password.

network_binding.help: customer_vpc tests and ingests from connectors-private-512 in the instance VPC. Stored on connector metadata.

instance_id.help: Runtime instance whose private subnets and CustomerConnectorSecurityGroup reach the database.

cdc.help: Logical CDC: enabled, publication, replication_slot, plugin=pgoutput.

cdc_publication.help: Existing publication (table owner CREATE PUBLICATION … FOR TABLE).

cdc_replication_slot.help: Logical slot name; created on first CDC run when the role has rds_replication.

tables.help: JSON string array of table names to include (inbound filter).

pg_pool_options.help: Optional pg Pool keys safelisted in runtime (max, connectionTimeoutMillis, application_name, …).

table.help: Outbound: destination table name for pushData when set with other dest fields.

primary_key.help: JSON string array of PK columns for upsert.

update_columns.help: JSON string array of columns to update on upsert.

column_mapping.help: JSON object map source→dest column names.

prerequisites: REPLICATION privilege on the connector role
Permission to CREATE PUBLICATION and pg_create_logical_replication_slot

metadata.managed_ingest_path: list_connector_entities → confirm_connector_entity_selection (connector-ingestion PKO); not the database-cdc workflow template

connection_config_spec.help: Use either a single connection_string for the driver or discrete host/database/credentials; optional pg_pool_options merges into the pg Pool (safelisted keys only).

placeholders.{{DB_USERNAME}}: Database username with SELECT on target tables (REPLICATION only if using CDC)
placeholders.{{REPLICATION_SLOT}}: Logical replication slot name for CDC

connector_package.description: Native PostgreSQL connector: private-VPC probe, table discovery, bounded preview/sample, and optional CDC when logical replication is ready.
follow_up_notes: Runtime: platform PostgresConnector (native) + connectors-private-512 for customer_vpc probe/sample (postgres-private-probe/1, postgres-private-sample/1).

auth_mode=iam applies to private probe, discovery, sample, and query ingestion. It rejects connection_string, a stored password, pg_pool_options password/ssl overrides, and CDC. Tokens are signed per connection and never stored or logged. The runtime principal needs rds-db:connect.
custom_settings_schema documents PostgresConnectorCustomSettings for UX/docs; runtime validation is in platform TypeScript.
Discovery and sampling need SELECT only. CDC needs wal_level=logical (or rds.logical_replication=1) plus REPLICATION / publication+slot privileges.
Actions: test_connection, list_collections (tables), capture_samples (persist), fetch_data (preview-only), push_data. Listing/preview/sample never start ingestion.
